name: frame-times-street
js: (async()=>{const o=window.__captureShot||{};const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));const dts=[];let last=performance.now(),stop=false;const t0=last;const tick=()=>{const n=performance.now();dts.push([n-t0,n-last]);last=n;if(!stop)requestAnimationFrame(tick);};requestAnimationFrame(tick);const wf=o.ftWaitFor;if(wf){const lim=performance.now()+120000;while(performance.now()<lim){let ok=false;try{ok=!!(0,eval)(wf);}catch(e){}if(ok){window.__ftMark&&window.__ftMark('wait done');break;}await sleep(250);}await sleep((o.ftTailSeconds??4)*1000);}else{await sleep((o.ftSeconds??20)*1000);}stop=true;const d=dts.map((x)=>x[1]).sort((a,b)=>a-b);const q=(p)=>d[Math.min(d.length-1,Math.floor(d.length*p))];const marks=(window.__ftMarks||[]).map(([name,at])=>({name,t:Math.round(at-t0)})).filter((m)=>m.t>=0);return {seconds:Math.round(dts[dts.length-1][0]/100)/10,frames:d.length,p50:q(.5),p95:q(.95),p99:q(.99),max:d[d.length-1],over50:d.filter((x)=>x>50).length,over100:d.filter((x)=>x>100).length,over200:d.filter((x)=>x>200).length,series:dts.map((x)=>[Math.round(x[0]),Math.round(x[1]*10)/10]),marks,heapMB:performance.memory&&Math.round(performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize/1048576)};})()
